CA.rationale: No attention/processing condition linked to identified content was asserted.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates) and an explicit origin/organization field are present for the same referent and time.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation condition is linked to content organization/access in the text.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify represented items (colour-labeled coordinate sets) at named referents and current time.

D.rationale: Content coordinates and a separate origin/representation-status field are both present for the same referent, distinguishing content from its status/organization.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/organization metadata and inherited/current representation tags describe how contents are organized/accessed.
